name: Dr Aneta Kotevski
title: Psychologist
description: Aneta is a registered and endorsed clinical and health psychologist and an AHPRA board approved supervisor in clinical and health psychology. With a Doctorate in Psychology from the University of Melbourne, she has over 16 years – experience practising in both private and public health care settings and currently leads a professional, growing and diverse psychology practice at Myndful Psychology. She is an accredited EMDR practitioner and a member of the EMDR Association of Australia. She is also provides Schema Therapy. Aneta has expertise in assisting individuals with: Mood and anxiety disorders Stress, coping and adjustment issues Adjustment to medical diagnoses and life change Pain and anger management Somatoform and Sleep disorders Self-management of chronic health conditions e.g., Pain Complex Trauma (C-PTSD), PTSD, and stressful life events
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Dr David Horne
title: Psychologist
description: I trained in Clinical Psychology at the Institute of Psychiatry, University of London and then took up a post in the Medical Faculty of the University of Melbourne with responsibility for psychology courses for medical, dental and physiotherapy students and clinical psychology services to the Royal Melbourne Hospital. I now work entirely in private practice. I have knowledge and skills in working with adults with an array of issues, including adjustment concerns, anxiety, trauma, depression and coping with serious physical illnesses, such as cancer.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Martin Mitrevski
title: Psychologist
description: Martin is a clinical psychologist and board-approved supervisor based in Fitzroy North, providing evidence-based mental healthcare for adults (18+). Working from the integrative Fitzroy North Medical Clinic on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays, Martin collaborates with a multidisciplinary team of medical and allied health specialists to support shared patient care.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr Zoe Gibbs
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: ** Accepting new referrals** Zoe is a senior clinical psychologist with over 15years experience working with young people, adults, parents, and families struggling with a variety of presentations; including emotion regulation difficulties, Anxiety and Depression, Relationship Issues, Stress and Adjustment to life changes, Trauma and parent/carer support. Zoe has extensive experience working in public and private mental health settings in Australia, the United Kingdom and Canada.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder

name: Jacqueline Adler
title: Psychologist
description: Many years experience working with adults, children, adolescents, parents and couples. Extensive experience in providing supervision and teaching to clinicians as well as providing theoretical seminars and seminars in infant observation for training programs in adult psychoanalytic psychotherapy and child and adolescent psychoanalytic psychotherapy.
specialties: Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dr David Spektor
title: Psychologist
description: In any therapy – What went wrong, must go right, – said David Malan, a wonderful human and master therapist. What he meant was that it is within the therapeutic relationship that transformative change can happen.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

name: Mahnaz Daraj
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist and psychodynamic psychotherapist. I offer individual therapy to adults who experience a diverse range of difficulties. These may include depression, anxiety, personality disorders, trauma, loss and grief, relationship problems and low self-esteem.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dr Sara Taylor
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Sara Taylor is the Director of The Melbourne Centre of Psychotherapy and Consultancy. Sara has held a Masters of Psychology since 2001 and has a PhD from the University of Melbourne. Areas of specific interest and expertise include trauma, complex trauma, PTSD, sexual abuse, sexual assault, domestic violence, and adult survivors of childhood trauma and abuse.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy
